scenarios.title: Successfully validate first acceptance criterion with valid input
preconditions: Given first acceptance criterion is configured
And second acceptance criterion is configured
And system is in ready state

steps.action: When user accesses the feature
steps.expectedResult: Feature interface is displayed and accessible

steps.action: When user provides valid input meeting first criterion
steps.expectedResult: System accepts the input without errors

steps.action: When user submits the request
steps.expectedResult: System processes request successfully

steps.action: Then system confirms successful completion
steps.expectedResult: Success message is displayed and data is saved

scenarios.expectedResult: First acceptance criterion is successfully validated and system responds with confirmation

scenarios.title: Successfully validate second acceptance criterion with valid configuration
preconditions: Given first acceptance criterion is configured
And second acceptance criterion is configured

steps.action: When user initiates the process
steps.expectedResult: Process starts and UI updates accordingly

steps.action: When user provides input meeting second criterion
steps.expectedResult: System validates input against second criterion

steps.action: When validation completes
steps.expectedResult: System confirms second criterion is satisfied

steps.action: Then system proceeds to next step
steps.expectedResult: Workflow continues without interruption

scenarios.expectedResult: Second acceptance criterion is successfully validated and workflow proceeds as expected
scenarios.automationHint: Selenium: WebElement input = driver.findElement(By.name('criterion-input')); input.sendKeys('valid-value'); driver.findElement(By.id('validate-btn')).click(); WebDriverWait wait = new WebDriverWait(driver, 10); wait.until(ExpectedConditions.visibilityOfElementLocated(By.className('validation-success')));

preconditions: Given first acceptance criterion is configured
And second acceptance criterion is configured
And all system dependencies are available

steps.action: When user starts the complete workflow
steps.expectedResult: System initializes and displays workflow interface

steps.action: When user completes first criterion requirements
steps.expectedResult: First criterion validation passes successfully

steps.action: When user completes second criterion requirements
steps.expectedResult: Second criterion validation passes successfully

steps.action: When user finalizes the workflow
steps.expectedResult: System confirms both criteria are met

steps.action: Then workflow completes successfully
steps.expectedResult: Success confirmation displayed and data persisted

scenarios.expectedResult: Complete workflow executes successfully with both acceptance criteria validated
scenarios.automationHint: Selenium: Execute full workflow; verify each criterion step; assert final state with driver.findElement(By.id('workflow-complete')).isDisplayed(); verify database records created;

scenarios.title: Invalid input fails first acceptance criterion validation
preconditions: Given first acceptance criterion is configured
And system is ready to accept input

steps.action: When user provides invalid input for first criterion
steps.expectedResult: System captures the invalid input

steps.action: When system validates the input
steps.expectedResult: Validation detects input does not meet first criterion

steps.action: Then system displays appropriate error message
steps.expectedResult: Clear error message indicates first criterion not met

steps.action: And system prevents further processing
steps.expectedResult: Workflow is blocked and no data is saved

scenarios.expectedResult: Invalid input is rejected with clear error message and no data persistence occurs
scenarios.automationHint: Selenium: driver.findElement(By.id('input-field')).sendKeys('invalid-data'); driver.findElement(By.id('submit-btn')).click(); assert driver.findElement(By.className('error-message')).getText().contains('criterion'); verify no database changes;

steps.action: When system validates second criterion configuration
steps.expectedResult: System detects missing or invalid configuration
